ios.desc:
Winston is the ultimate game tracker to help you organize, track, and discover video games. With features like gameplay tracking, custom lists, and a release calendar, it helps you to stay on top of your games. Whether you're a casual gamer or a hardcore enthusiast, Winston ensures you never miss a game and always know what to play next.

Key Features:
- Privacy-focused: No sign-in required and none of your data is collected.
- Detailed Game Info: Access trailers, screenshots, and more. Powered by IGDB.
- Release Date Alerts: Never miss a release date again.
- Game Tracking: Mark progress, track playtime, and decide what you're going to play next.
- Sale Tracking: See which games in your Wishlist are on sale. Supports prices from Steam, GOG, and more. Powered by IsThereAnyDeal.

Track Your Gameplay
- Add games to your queue
- Mark games as "Started," "Paused," "Completed," or "Stopped"
- Track playtime for all your games

Discover New Games
- Browse trending games or filter by platform (PS5, Xbox, Switch, PC, and more)
- Search for a specific game on IGDB by title
- Automatically find games by pasting links from Steam, Reddit, IGDB, Wikipedia, Twitch, and Fandom
- See trailers, screenshots, critic ratings, release dates, keywords, and more

Stay on Top of Releases
- Add upcoming games to your calendar
- Get notified when your tracked games launch

Create Lists & Add Notes
- Organize your games with custom lists
- Keep a gaming journal with one or more notes for each game
- Rate your games and remember which games you’ve enjoyed the most

Start tracking your games today with Winston!

Video game data is provided by igdb.com and isthereanydeal.com. Winston is not endorsed or certified by any of the listed services.

I'm the creator of Winston, a simple yet powerful video game tracker for iPhone and iPad. Today I updated the app with one of its biggest updates yet. Version 2.2 features a redesigned search experience and redesigned game detail views.

Check it out and let me know what you think!
